input_fields.name: home_settings
input_fields.description: One known Home-view definition for the target user's/session's navigation settings.

input_fields.name: target_session
input_fields.description: Unique maximized SpaceClaim session in which Home is to be restored.

result_fields.name: home_view_state
result_fields.description: Applied Home definition, session identity, observed camera state, and geometry-unchanged observation.

procedure: Confirm target_session and record the active Home definition without replacing it.
Issue one calibrated H/Home action or one verified View-menu Home command.
Observe the resulting camera orientation/scale and return home_view_state.
If multiple profiles or an unknown Home definition are present, stop with needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous session/profile, unavailable Home command, blocked viewport, or an unobservable camera result.
Do not infer a universal Home orientation from another user or machine.
